title: He Ditched the Knife and Played Dumb When Cops Caught Him
description:
New Jersey police responded to an alleged armed robbery near the Atlantic City boardwalk in October 2023. The suspects were nowhere to be found when officers arrived. When police tracked down the two suspects, they played dumb before being arrested.
